articles.title: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
articles.summary: Google released TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library that moves KV caches and weights across TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage and network. Google reports over 90% lower KV transfer latency on 235B to 480B MoE models. The post Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
